planets.name: K2-152 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-152 with a 32.7-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-152 b was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-152. Its orbit and size follow Livingston et al. 2018's fit, the archive's default.
